name: Concept Mapping
description: Map SNOMED CT concepts to other terminologies including ICD-10, LOINC, RxNorm, and UMLS CUIs with confidence scores and source tracking

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initialize mapper with SNOMED data paths

methods.name: _auto_detect_paths
methods.description: Automatically detect mapping files from UK Clinical RF2 directory

methods.name: load_icd_mapping
methods.description: Load ICD-10 mappings from SNOMED CT refset files

returns.description: Mapping of SNOMED CUIs to {icd_code, description, confidence, source}

methods.name: load_loinc_mapping
methods.description: Load LOINC mappings from SNOMED CT refset files

returns.description: Mapping of SNOMED CUIs to {loinc_code, description, confidence, source}

methods.name: map_to_icd10
methods.description: Map a single SNOMED CT concept to ICD-10 codes

returns.description: List of {icd_code, description, confidence, source} mappings

methods.name: map_to_loinc
methods.description: Map a single SNOMED CT concept to LOINC codes

returns.description: List of {loinc_code, description, confidence, source} mappings

methods.name: map_concept
methods.description: Map a SNOMED CT concept to all available terminologies

returns.description: Mapping results for ICD-10, LOINC, and RxNorm

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initialize mapper with SNOMED data paths

methods.name: load_snomed_to_umls
methods.description: Load SNOMED CT to UMLS CUI mappings

returns.description: Mapping of SNOMED CUIs to {umls_cui, confidence, source}

methods.name: load_umls_to_snomed
methods.description: Load UMLS CUI to SNOMED CT mappings (reverse mapping)

returns.description: Mapping of UMLS CUIs to {snomed_cui, confidence, source}

methods.name: map_to_umls
methods.description: Map SNOMED CT concept to UMLS CUI

methods.name: map_from_umls
methods.description: Map UMLS CUI to SNOMED CT concept

returns.description: True if valid UMLS CUI format

functions.name: map_concept
functions.description: Convenience function to map a SNOMED CT concept using ConceptMapper

returns.description: Mapping results for ICD-10, LOINC, RxNorm

functions.name: batch_map_concepts
functions.description: Map multiple SNOMED CT concepts at once

returns.description: Dict mapping each SNOMED CUI to its terminology mappings

functions.name: map_to_umls
functions.description: Map SNOMED CT concept to UMLS CUI using UMLSCIMapper

functions.name: map_from_umls
functions.description: Map UMLS CUI to SNOMED CT concept using UMLSCIMapper

functions.name: batch_map_to_umls
functions.description: Map multiple SNOMED CT concepts to UMLS CUIs in batch

returns.description: Dict mapping each SNOMED CUI to UMLS CUI mappings

example_usage: # Map SNOMED CT concept to ICD-10
# Map to multiple terminologies at once
from snomed_methods import UMLSCIMapper, map_to_umls, map_from_umls
